name: kilima-ondevice
description: Kilima — an on-device intent classifier for low-connectivity environments, with local training, quantization simulation and an offline CLI + web demo

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && node -e "import {cpSync} from 'fs'; import {resolve} from 'path'; cpSync(resolve('public'), resolve('dist/public'), {recursive: true}); console.log('Copied public to dist/public')"
